v24_scenario_setup.description: Claims a fixture and writes a checkpoint expecting v24_scenario_resume after a clean stop. The card then stops the server and starts it again.
commands: devtool scenario checkpoint v24 next v24_scenario_resume clean

v24_scenario_resume.description: The expected bundle after the restart. Must not start a session; the resume restores it. Expect the SCENARIO resume record with restoredFixtures=1, the fixture listed, and the placeholder resolving.

v24_wrong_bundle_control.description: Run this instead of the resume bundle while the checkpoint stands. Expect a refusal naming both bundles, with devtool.scenario.mismatch, and nothing from this bundle running.

v24_cleanup.description: Removes the fixture, abandons any scenario left, and stops the session.
